meta.name: linkedin-hooks
meta.description: Write high-converting LinkedIn hooks and first lines. Use when the user asks about LinkedIn hooks, first lines, openers, "see more" optimization, attention-grabbing intros, or post headlines. Do NOT use for post body structure (use storytelling) or end-of-post CTAs (use cta).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 写出吸引人的 LinkedIn 开场白和第一行
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你在 LinkedIn 上发帖需要抓住用户注意力
copy.tagline_en: Catch attention with LinkedIn hooks and first lines
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you write LinkedIn posts and need high-converting openers

howto.what: 装了这个技能后，Claude 会变成一个写 LinkedIn 帖子前 210 个字符（“看更多”之前的部分）的专家。它会根据 8 种钩子公式和多种开头策略，给你 2~3 个钩子选项，并说明每个使用了哪个公式、字数多少。
howto.when: 当你提到“LinkedIn 钩子”、“第一行”、“开头”、“‘看更多’优化”、“吸引注意的引言”或“帖子标题”等关键词时触发。不会用于帖子正文结构或结尾的行动号召。

say.text: 帮我写一个关于增长业绩的LinkedIn钩子。
say.note: Claude 会给出 2~3 个钩子选项，带公式和字数。

say.text: 我想测试一下好奇缺口开头的效果。
say.note: Claude 会使用好奇心缺口技术生成钩子。

say.text: 给一个反驳常见看法的帖子开头。
say.note: Claude 会采用 Myth Buster 公式。

howto.what_en: After installing this skill, Claude becomes a specialist in writing the first 210 characters of LinkedIn posts (the text visible before the 'see more' fold). It uses 8 hook formulas and multiple first-line strategies to provide 2-3 hook options, each with the formula used and character count noted.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks about LinkedIn hooks, first lines, openers, 'see more' optimization, attention-grabbing intros, or post headlines. Not used for post body structure or end-of-post CTAs.

say_en.text: Write a LinkedIn hook about growth results.
say_en.note: Claude will give 2-3 options with formula and character count.

say_en.text: Try a curiosity gap opener for me.
Start a post by busting a common myth.
